finding: Returning only the collision-safe stable registry slot for a warm exact-key hit is roughly three times cheaper than current lookup plus intrinsic deep assignment of the immutable adaptive table. The measured gap is large enough to justify a bounded handle-based provider repair.
repair_direction: Use integer stable registry slot handles, not raw pointers.
Registry entries remain immutable and non-evicting.
Warm hits bind by slot without copying support arrays.
Cache misses and full-registry fallback retain the existing caller-owned table path.
Exact-key identity and analytical fallback semantics remain authoritative.
nonclaims: This is a cache-operation microbenchmark, not an application speed claim.
No provider handle repair is admitted by F-AHL37 itself.
